title: datacursormode
summary: Control data cursor interaction mode for figures.
description: `datacursormode` toggles or configures MATLAB-compatible data cursor mode state. It returns a live data cursor manager object whose common properties can be read or updated through `get` and `set`.

examples.description: Use the data cursor manager object

notes: Statement-form `datacursormode()` toggles data cursor mode. Output-form `dcm = datacursormode()` returns a data cursor manager object.
The data cursor manager object supports `Enable`, `SnapToDataVertex`, `DisplayStyle`, `UpdateFcn`, and `FigureHandle` properties.
gpu_residency: `datacursormode` mutates plotting interaction metadata only. It does not gather or copy GPU-resident plot data.
